Why face-to-face

Makeup Is a Physical Craft. Brush Pressure, Blending Timing, and Skin Reading Do Not Survive a Screen.

In the studio, instructors stand beside you: adjusting your angle, correcting your blend, and fixing the habit while it forms.

Every class puts you on live faces, with branded cosmetics, professional tools, and lighting that matches a real client booking.

Signature programs

Three Ways Artists Start with Us.

All 11 classes →
01 Basic Fundamentals A 5-day makeup foundations program covering makeup science, face chart mapping, professional tools, day and night looks, and a graduation pictorial for your portfolio. Beginner to Professional 5 days · hands-on PHP 35,000 02 Bridal Masterclass A 5-day bridal makeup masterclass: long-wear bridal techniques, entourage application, client communication, and how to build a profitable bridal package. Professional 5 days · hands-on PHP 40,000 03 SFX Masterclass A 7-day special effects makeup masterclass covering bruises, burns, wounds, wax and scar work, blood staging, old-age effects, and prosthetic application, with a set-ready portfolio.
